name: edit-cut-reframe
description: Edits a customer's own footage into one finished file: trims; multi-cuts of chosen moments from a JSON edit plan rendered as one ffmpeg filter graph (reordered; each range padded, centre-cropped or crop-panned from viewed frames; join fades); resize or reframe to any even size; speed change; dead-air removal on request; captions burned last; intros and outros; voiceover or music replace, mix or duck; logo or text marks; slideshows; voice isolation or AI upscale on request; size-capped, GIF or WebM output; splice review. Use when: trim, cut, shorten, reorder, join, reframe, make a vertical or square version, resize, speed up, remove pauses, add a voiceover, music, watermark or intro, compress or convert a supplied video. NOT for: picking highlights (edit-highlights); captions alone on a finished video (edit-captions); beat-synced montages (edit-beat-montage); dubbing (voice-dub); generated or restyled footage (media-video-generation); multi-shot films (media-video-production); measuring files (media-qc).
